name: Chao Farm
description: Green Hill Zone, 100 of its 183 rings turned into Chao eggs (placeable type 0 -> 32). The in-game zone counter reads 111 eggs / 85 coins against the build's 110+1 and 83+2, so the collection system reads ptype and the conversion is confirmed. chao_level 3 is still on, so every Chao hatches at Level 1 holding its Max-tier item: equip Choo and count PP regen (+1 at Level 1, +3 at Max), or Ovus and count revives (1 vs 3). The chests are deliberately left vanilla: putting Chao item ids in them was tried and the reward screen shows the Chao and then nothing enters the collection, which matches vanilla never granting a Chao through a chest, shop or drop even once.
